name: Discussion Channel
description: A realtime chat channel for a space. Editors chat, react with Phosphor Light icons and delete their own messages; the owner renames the channel, can delete any message, and chooses whether Viewer-role members may participate too (off by default). Everyone else the frame reaches, including anyone it is published to, reads the channel live without posting. Messages and reactions are the space's own tables, discussion_messages and discussion_reactions, synced with the space; the name and the viewers toggle are settings rows of the space.
